source_title: 'Drishyam 3' day 30: Ajay Devgn's film doubles 'Drishyam 2's 30-day collection
source_excerpt: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion', starring Ajay Devgn, has maintained its box office momentum after completing 30 days in theatres. The film collected Rs 1.60 cr net in India on Saturday, October 31, registering a 60% increase over the previous day's Rs 1 cr. Its total domestic net collection has now reached Rs 375.60 cr, while the India gross stands at Rs 449.84 cr.The film has also continued to contribute to the box office through its overseas performance. It earned Rs 25 lakh from international markets on Day 30, taking its overseas gross collection to Rs 132.55 cr. This brings its worldwide gross total to Rs 582.39 cr.According to Sacnilk, the film recorded 3,030 shows across India on Saturday. An estimated 79,067 tickets were sold during the day. The cumulative ticket sales have reached 1,63,11,873 since its release.'Drishyam 3' witnesses a 60% rise on Day 30The film's Saturday earnings marked a noticeable improvement over its previous day's performance. After collecting Rs 1 cr on Friday, the Ajay Devgn-starrer added Rs 1.60 cr on Saturday. The increase came as the film entered its fifth week at the box office.Its performance indicates that the thriller continues to draw audiences despite completing a month-long theatrical run.Film's weekly collections show a gradual decline'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' opened strongly, collecting Rs 245.50 cr net and Rs 294.60 cr gross in its first week. The second week brought in Rs 87.50 cr net and Rs 104.45 cr gross, representing a 64.4% decline from the opening week.The third week contributed Rs 28.85 cr net and Rs 34.47 cr gross. Collections dropped by another 67% during this period. In its fourth week, the film earned Rs 11.15 cr net and Rs 13.20 cr gross, marking a 61.4% decline.The first two days of the fifth week added Rs 2.60 cr net and Rs 3.12 cr gross. These figures have taken the film's overall India gross beyond Rs 449 cr.'Drishyam 3' earns nearly twice as much as 'Drishyam 2'The latest instalment has established a significant lead over its predecessor in their respective 30-day box office runs. 'Drishyam 2' had collected Rs 218.79 cr in India net collections at the same stage.On its 30th day, Saturday, December 17, 'Drishyam 2' earned Rs 2.02 cr net and Rs 2.38 cr gross. Its collection increased by 88.8% compared with the previous day. The comparison highlights the difference in their domestic performances after a month in theatres.Hindi 2D occupancy improves towards night showsThe Hindi 2D version of 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' recorded an overall theatre occupancy of 17.36% on Saturday. Morning screenings registered 8.83%, while afternoon shows recorded 17.42%.The occupancy figure increased to 19.83% during evening screenings. Night shows registered the highest attendance at 20.67%. This indicates stronger audience turnout during the later screenings.What is 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' about?The latest chapter follows Vijay Salgaonkar years after he successfully evaded the law. However, his past catches up with him when Meera Deshmukh returns with a different motive. Rather than pursuing justice, she is driven by revenge.Vijay also faces a new challenge in the form of a powerful Crime Branch officer. The officer's investigation puts his carefully constructed alibis and psychological defences to the test. The story explores whether Vijay can protect his family and stay ahead of the renewed investigation.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources.
